meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. The project guide shows progress, stage outcomes and blocker/difficulty/change alerts; the requirement pool feeds the current need or a project; the workspace turns a project into member tasks and sends task details into one DSH conversation per project; the talent pool integrates every employee with skills, availability and profiles; Organization shows departments, teams, coverage and single-point skills; Team match evaluates organization-wide combinations and reports gaps, dependencies and remaining capacity. Capability advice covers skill upgrades, knowledge topics and mentor-led training; profiles include a skill-center training planner with GitHub research; after matching, project feedback is recorded locally. Import CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown or XLSX. Employee/project data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
